data.title: The Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists convicted in national security trial
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong court sentenced three pro-democracy activists on Friday who organised annual vigils to mark China's deadly Tiananmen crackdown on charges of "incitement to subversion".

data.title: Appreciation, anger await as Trump heads to Irish golf resort
data.description: DOONBEG — In the windswept village of Doonbeg on Ireland's Atlantic coast, Donald Trump is less polarising United States president and more golf resort owner credited with bringing jobs and money to a remote corner of the country.

data.title: Party leaders trade barbs before Swedish election
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden's party leaders traded barbs on housing, schools, jobs and the climate in one of their final televised debates ahead of Sunday's general election, which could see a left-wing government come to power.

data.title: Manchester derby poses Maresca's first big test, Chelsea aim to end Hull Honeymoon
data.description: MANCHESTER — Enzo Maresca faces his first major test since stepping into Pep Guardiola's shoes as City visit United in the Manchester derby on Sunday, while Arsenal aim to extend their flawless start at Sunderland.

data.title: Government needs to build public confidence on disaster alerts
data.description: Almost half of people have shown no trust in the disaster warning system in a KPI Poll, which reflected more attempts were needed to boost their confidence.

data.title: STGT Unveils Future of Gloves at IRGCE 2026, Setting Global Clean World Standard
data.description: Sri Trang Gloves (Thailand) Public Company Limited (STGT), a global leader in sustainable rubber glove manufacturing and distribution, is reinforcing its role in shaping the future of the rubber glove industry on the international stage through its participation in the 12th International Rubber Glove Conference & Exhibition (IRGCE 2026), held at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, Malaysia, from 8 – 10 September 2026. At the event, STGT highlighted its “Clean World Clean Gloves” (CWCG) concept as a key framework for elevating industry standards beyond product quality and performance to encompass transparency, responsibility, and sustainability throughout the entire value chain.

data.title: “Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026” elevates Bangkok as a global watch destination
data.description: BANGKOK, Thailand — Siam Paragon, reaffirming its position as a global landmark and one of the world’s premier Global Luxury Destinations, is set to host a defining landmark of haute horology with the second edition of “Siam Paragon Bangkok Watch Week 2026.” The event is a “Celebration of Watch Culture,” bringing new depth and perspective to the world of horology through an exceptional gathering of more than 45 prestigious international watch maisons, renowned industry leaders, discerning collectors and passionate enthusiasts from across the globe.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rambolek stripped of title on scale after missing weight
data.description: Thailand’s Rambolek Chor Ajalaboon has lost his ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai world title on the scale after missing weight in Bangkok – leaving Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri as the only man who can claim the vacant belt at The Inner Circle 30.

data.title: Statecraft or scripture: Why Pacific nations want Jerusalem embassies
data.description: SYDNEY — An ancient Biblical prophecy lies at the heart of a Pacific islands push to open embassies on contested ground in Jerusalem, experts and former diplomats told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: China, Iran among countries that have used AI to aid spying, Anthropic says
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO - Anthropic said on Thursday it shut down multiple cases of state-sponsored surveillance operations that used its artificial intelligence (AI) models, and warned that governments and state-aligned actors are increasingly using AI to spy on ethnic minorities and dissidents.

data.title: Hong Kong sentences Tiananmen activists to between 5 and 7 years in jail
data.description: HONG KONG — A Hong Kong court handed three Tiananmen vigil activists jail sentences of between five and seven years on Friday for national security crimes, following a trial that has drawn international condemnation.

data.title: The paradox of death
data.description: Uruphong Raksasad has returned with the camera to capture the vanishing countryside in Thailand, a place where generations once shared history, values and resources, though not all equally benefited from it. In Songsakan, villagers join a funeral procession to transport a body to the cremation ground. Through this, Uruphong quietly observes his childhood memory in the midst of change.

data.title: Stray Kids' 'World Tour '  comes to Impact Arena for 2 nights
data.description: Stray Kids will bring their "World Tour " to Impact Arena for two spectacular nights. Live Nation Tero announced the global K-pop powerhouse will perform in Bangkok on Jan 16-17, with tickets available via ticketmaster.co.th from Sept 21.

data.title: Running on empty
data.description: The Runner, a new thriller film on Prime Video, has the former Wonder Woman Gal Gadot playing a mother forced into a madman's game to save her son with one simple task -- running.

data.title: Israeli-made film about Gaza gets 25-minute ovation at Venice premiere
data.description: VENICE - A chilling new documentary about Israel's AI-powered mass killing of civilians in Gaza from two Oscar-winning Israeli filmmakers received a 25-minute ovation at its premiere at the Venice Film Festival on Thursday.

data.title: Watch these spaces
data.description: Around 50 participating brands emanate the dynamism of the watch industry at the inaugural Time & Treasures organised by Central Chidlom and Central Embassy.

data.title: Ancient, modern combine in limited editions
data.description: Showcased at the Time & Treasures event, two commemorative timepieces epitomise Japanese aesthetic and microengineering. The limited editions illustrate how ancestral techniques and modern technology can equally convey artistic expressions on the dial.

data.title: Kieran opts out of squad for LA push
data.description: Thai-American distance runner Kieran Tuntivate has spoken of his regret at missing the 20th Asian Games in Japan, revealing he turned down a place in Thailand's athletics squad to focus on his marathon ambitions instead.

data.title: Musk threatens legal action over documentary
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk's lawyers put the makers of a new four-hour documentary about the multibillionaire on formal legal notice days before its premiere, warning that the film defames him.

data.title: Tilapia exports face scrutiny
data.description: A civil society group has called for a traceability investigation into the import and export of blackchin tilapia, citing data showing more than 320,000 fish were exported before the species was reported to have spread in Thailand.

data.title: Tremor recorded as Israel says Hezbollah tunnels destroyed in south Lebanon
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel said Thursday it demolished key tunnels built by the Iran-backed Hezbollah group beneath the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, triggering a 4.1 magnitude tremor.

data.title: Man United, Bayern cruise as Como make dream Champions League start
data.description: PARIS - Manchester United celebrated their return to the Champions League with a 4-0 thrashing of Sabah on Thursday, as Cesc Fabregas's Como impressed on their debut in Europe's premier club competition.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 11
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Thai Airways drug case nears detention deadline
data.description: Prosecutors have ordered the urgent conclusion of an investigation into a transnational drug network linked to a Thai Airways flight attendant, setting Sept 14 as the deadline to prevent three detained suspects from being released.

data.title: First meeting set to hasten conciliation
data.description: Thailand is ready for the first conciliation meeting with Cambodia, scheduled in Singapore from Monday to Wednesday.

data.title: Cloud tech spurs real-life concerns
data.description: Thailand is seeking to capitalise on investment relocating from the United States and China amid geopolitical tensions, but the rapid expansion of data-centre infrastructure has raised concerns over its impact on energy security, electricity and water demand.

data.title: New movies out this week: Sept 11-17
data.description: Six new releases that hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: Pheu Thai chief denies Klatham pact
data.description: Pheu Thai Party leader and Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed reports of a secret political deal between the Bhumjaithai (BJT) and Klatham parties.

data.title: Klong Toey oil leak downplayed as 'minor issue'
data.description: Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn has sought to reassure residents that oil contamination in Bangkok's Klong Toey district was caused by seepage from a pipeline rather than a major leak. He said engineers should be able to seal the affected section.

data.title: Pit bull kills second owner
data.description: A pit bull mauled its 70-year-old owner to death at a rented house in Bangkok on Wednesday, police said.
